obernants.operator: tokens groups characters between literal double quotes and splits Unicode whitespace outside; there is no escape syntax. Args requires lowercase ASCII key names, splits the first '=', rejects repeated spellings and positions after any key, and validates complete outer quote pairs. text trims value edges; quote flags are enforced by ID/word consumers but intentionally ignored by some numeric/tag/text consumers.

obernants.operator: Args scans token order. Invalid key syntax precedes duplicate detection for that token; duplicate detection precedes quote validation. A malformed later command cannot override an earlier duplicate or positional-after-key error. Oracle checks unknown command plus duplicate keys.

obernants.operator: take removes the first matching key preserving order of remaining triples. Typed consumers propagate a first error; attrs consumes all remaining keys in order. done rejects first remaining position before first remaining key.
